title: Surjectivity component of affine formal quotient projection
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal of A, J the ideal sheaf on Spec A associated with I through GammaSpecIso, M any A-module, and m>0. Define p as the tilde/global-sections unit M to Gamma(Spec A, tilde M), followed by global sections of the explicit cokernel projection formalModuleQuotientπ J m (tilde M) of def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module. Then p is surjective.

source.place: Tags 01I8 and 01IC; Tag 087W in coherent.tex, affine module correspondence

proof.text: Use the ideal-times theorem for quasi-coherence of the positive ideal power. The tensor-product theorem and preservation of quasi-coherence under cokernels and kernels show quasi-coherence of the image defining its product with tilde M. Apply the affine cokernel-image theorem at the whole spectrum to obtain sectionwise surjectivity, and compose with the bijective tilde unit. No ideal-power range computation is needed.

theorem formalModuleQuotient_affine_projection_surjective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    let p := (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of A)).hom.app M ≫
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ J m ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A)).obj M))
    Function.Surjective p
